notes: Style v2 Warden health bar: a thin slate well (3 px fill) with an ink rim, a lit ash hairline above, a lit slate floor where health is missing and a 45-degree blade-cut right end, plus a small cut-stone emblem holding the Warden's pale iris heart. Anchor = top center. fill_rect [x, y, w, h] is the well in cell coords; fill it from the left with hud_bossbar_fill columns: 0 = health (dried rose), 1 = recently lost chip (bone/ash), 2 = bone hit flash. Name: font_small 'The Warden' above the bar at x = fill_rect.x.
